response.sql: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, COUNT(c.client_id) as client_count FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), total_clients AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) as total FROM region_counts), region_shares AS (SELECT rc.region, rc.client_count, CAST(rc.client_count AS REAL) / CAST(tc.total AS REAL) as share FROM region_counts rc CROSS JOIN total_clients tc), average_share_value AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM region_shares), above_average_regions AS (SELECT rs.client_count, rs.share, av.avg_share FROM region_shares rs CROSS JOIN average_share_value av WHERE rs.share > av.avg_share) SELECT SUM(client_count) as total_clients, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_distance_above_average FROM above_average_regions
